Term Map (canonical names — pull from here, never from memory)
streaming crossing onset
nodes.rationale: Continuous dense windows ask whether onset is imminent; anchored event-relative windows ask a different question.

nodes.label: hard temporal negatives
nodes.rationale: An eventual crosser before the forecast horizon is a negative in streaming, omitted by event-anchored sampling.

nodes.label: gap decomposition
nodes.rationale: Separate the portion threshold recalibration recovers from the residual ranking gap; residual is not a causal identification without matched-size control.

nodes.label: behavior preserving rebuild
nodes.rationale: Port legacy behavior with characterization fixtures before intentional methodological changes.

nodes.label: golden fixture parity
nodes.rationale: Capture old behavior before porting, distinguish exact parity from documented intentional departures.

nodes.label: v2 validity repair
nodes.rationale: Resolve threshold leakage, future-label misuse, censoring, correlation, seeding, model selection, missing ablations and normalization.

nodes.label: pose58 intrinsic extrinsic geometry
nodes.rationale: 49 pose features remove bbox position and scale already carried by 9 motion channels; raw keypoints stored once, features built at read time.

nodes.label: flattened pose temporal encoder
nodes.rationale: Reuse GRU and attention instead of adding ST-GCN; partial confidence-weighted skeleton and bounded supporting-study scope favor feature engineering.

nodes.label: pose rides motions tensor
nodes.rationale: Preserve collate and forward contracts by widening motions; no separate PoseMotionEncoder class was implemented.

nodes.label: pretrained tinyvit choice
nodes.rationale: Avoid legacy dimension collapse, tiny receptive windows and data-hungry from-scratch ViT. TinyViT baseline choice is historical, not the current paper model.

nodes.label: frozen batchnorm recipe detour
nodes.rationale: Image-mode probe exonerated the feature cache; true eval freezing and/or trainable projection explain worse performance, not cache corruption.

nodes.label: onset timing under censoring
nodes.rationale: Represent event time and observed follow-up rather than fabricate negatives for missing futures; maintain probability of onset within 32 frames.

nodes.label: detection curve primary metric
nodes.rationale: Count detection and earliest qualifying lead time under a hard false-alarm budget; account for per-window and per-track alarms separately.

nodes.label: single seed two to six fold claim
nodes.rationale: Historical single-seed claim was retracted by multi-seed campaigns; this document still presents it as current.

nodes.label: preregistered multi seed criterion
nodes.rationale: Hazard mean must exceed binary by more than sum of sample SDs at at least 3 of 5 budgets; otherwise inconclusive.

nodes.label: pixel free v4 canonical recipe
nodes.rationale: Remove image decoding, standardize pose58, use batch32 and shuffled chunks; select best checkpoint on validation AUC.

nodes.label: v4 manual no go override
nodes.rationale: User launched v4 despite memorization NO-GO; no memorization fix was adopted, and overfitting must be stated.

nodes.label: v4 twenty run campaign
nodes.rationale: Replace older image-recipe paper results with 20 pixel-free runs; 3 seeds except the two Model A runs.

nodes.label: hazard binary inconclusive
nodes.rationale: No budget clears the preregistered spread criterion; hazard is not demonstrated to detect better; binary warns earlier on average.

nodes.label: who versus when diagnosis
nodes.rationale: Anchored model retains eventual-crosser discrimination (AUC 0.799) but imminent-vs-distant ordering is inverted (0.414).

nodes.label: posthoc model combination negative
nodes.rationale: Pre-registered anchored-streaming score combination does not materially improve the streaming baseline.

nodes.label: unrun matched size control
nodes.rationale: Anchored 4.9k versus streaming 88k training windows confounds protocol attribution; manuscript pending marker remains.

nodes.label: early peak memorization
nodes.rationale: 19 of 20 runs peak within eight epochs then validation declines while training loss falls; best-checkpoint reporting must be explicit.

nodes.label: lookahead96 bin4 horizon32
nodes.rationale: 96-frame future covers the 64-frame confusable band beyond H32, with 24 bins and 8 bins in the readout horizon.

nodes.label: f1 spread prose inconsistency
nodes.rationale: Introduction claims SD exceeds mean gap, but current macros give 0.008 and 0.025 versus 0.034 gap; the source comment says gap slightly exceeds their sum.

nodes.label: model a seed scope inconsistency
nodes.rationale: Setup says every configuration uses 3 seeds; matrix caption says Model A seed42 only.

nodes.rationale: Header retracts old headline and records v4, while body retains old claims, baseline identity, completed work as open, and outdated narrative status.
